Your dual expertise—part consultant, part seller—positions you to bridge technical capability and business value in ways that resonate with executive stakeholders.

Build and refine the qualification criteria, account strategy, sales motion, and the pitch.
Build pipeline and generate revenue for Autonomous Finance, Procurement, and Legal Workflow solutions.

Establish trusted relationships with executive sponsors and collaborate across teams.

Balance executive presence with technical know-how.
Simplify technology into clear business narratives.
Thrive in ambiguous situations and solve complex problems.
Prioritize high-impact opportunities.
Work well in matrixed environments.

The ideal candidate will possess a proven track record of success in BDR roles, particularly within the cybersecurity or enterprise software industry. They will be a self-starter with excellent communication and organisational skills, and a strong understanding of the sales process.

Proactively identify and generate new business opportunities through targeted outbound prospecting, including cold calling, emailing, social selling, and leveraging relevant industry events.
Qualify and convert inbound leads generated from marketing campaigns, events and website inquiries.
Conduct thorough research to understand prospect needs, pain points, and business objectives.
Utilise CRM (Salesforce) to accurately track and manage all activities and interactions.

Schedule discovery calls for qualified sales opportunities for Account Executives.
Develop and maintain a strong understanding of Armis' products and services, and their value proposition to help accelerate opportunity progression.
Collaborate with marketing, channel and sales teams to optimise lead generation and qualification processes.
Territory buildout responsibilities in partnership with your Account Executives (account mapping, research, persona mapping)

Stay up-to-date on industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies in the cybersecurity space.

Provide feedback to marketing and product marketing teams based on prospect interactions and market insights.

Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly targets for qualified opportunities and meetings.
Provide regular reports on activity, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Participate in ongoing training and development to enhance sales skills and product knowledge.

Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a BDR or sales development role, preferably in the cybersecurity or enterprise software industry.
Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales targets.
Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and sales enablement tools.
Experience working collaboratively across business functions (Channel, Sales, Marketing).

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong prospecting, qualification, and creative problem solving skills.
Ability to build rapport and establish relationships with potential customers.
Strong organisational and time management skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Demonstrated ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into specific solutions with measurable business outcomes.

Hungry & Hardworking, self-motivated, results-driven, and goal-oriented with a strong desire to succeed.

We are a dynamic AI start-up based in the heart of Munich, setting the global standard for AI Coaching. While most AI companies are working on replacing human labor, we are unlocking the uniquely human strengths that drive lasting business outcomes for our enterprise clients.

Our in-house AI technology helps sales and service teams at global enterprises earn trust and win deals through realistic client simulations and deep behavioral feedback. Join our international team that is not just building a human-centric product, but redefining customer relationships.
About the role (Munich-based, German speaking): You are the tip of the spear for our enterprise motion in DACH. Paired one to one with a Senior Account Executive, you own the top of the funnel.

You research target accounts, reach the right people through cold calls, email and LinkedIn, and open conversations with senior commercial buyers in Sales Enablement and Commercial Excellence. This is a dedicated pod, not a shared pool. You feed a proven closer, learn enterprise selling from the inside, and grow into an Account Executive yourself.
Tasks
Generating qualified pipeline through proactive, multi-channel outbound: cold calls, personalized email sequences, and LinkedIn, into your target accounts
Researching accounts and buying centers, and identifying the right senior stakeholders in Sales Enablement, Commercial Excellence, and Service Ownership
Running crisp first conversations that qualify need and book meetings your paired Account Executive accepts
Working hand in hand with one senior Account Executive in a dedicated 1:1 pod: shared account plans, daily coordination, joint territory strategy
Keeping the CRM (HubSpot) clean and disciplined, so pipeline, activities, and handoffs stay reliable
Testing and improving messaging, sequences, and target lists together with marketing and your AE
Using Retorio's own platform to sharpen your outbound and discovery skills, and to know the product you sell from the inside

2 to 4 years of B2B SaaS outbound experience as an SDR or BDR, ideally into enterprise
A track record of consistently hitting or beating pipeline and meeting targets, with real numbers you can speak to
Strong on cold outbound: you can open a cold call, steer the conversation, and handle objections without a script
Business-fluent German (C1+) and English, the role is Munich-based and sells into the DACH market
Coachable, self-driven, and resilient: you seek feedback, act on it, and stay in the game through rejection
A clear ambition to grow into an Account Executive (see the path below)
Comfortable with modern outbound tooling: CRM (HubSpot), sales engagement, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and data enrichment
Bonus: experience selling into Pharma, Telco, FMCG, Insurance, Automotive, or Retail, or into sales enablement, coaching, or L&D-adjacent buyers

From the preset toggles, enable: Above-average compensation, Flexible working hours, and High-performance culture. As custom entries:
Uncapped commission with a competitive OTE: your earnings scale with the pipeline and the deals you help create
A clear path to Account Executive: this role is built as a launchpad, with a realistic move to AE in 18 to 24 months, and faster for a standout performer
A dedicated 1:1 partnership with a senior Account Executive who coaches you every week, not a shared BDR pool
Six-figure enterprise deals and reference clients across pharma, insurance, telecom, FMCG, retail and automotive
Direct access to the founders and real influence on how we sell
A product with a genuine scientific moat, built on the Warmth and Competence framework from TU Munich research, that you also use to get better yourself
A central Munich office with an international team
If you want to break into enterprise sales the right way, learning from a senior closer while building the pipeline that wins six-figure deals, send us your CV and a short note on the best cold call or outbound sequence you have run. You will hear back within a week, and the process is fast: intro call and deep dive with your future AE partner, a practical case that includes a live cold-call exercise and a conversation with a founder.

The Reality of This Role This is not a "relationship management" role or a "check-the-box" administrative position. We are looking for a pure hunter who thrives on the road and views a "No" as a tactical puzzle to be solved. If you require a desk, a steady routine, or a manager to tell you who to call next, do not apply.

Who You Are (The Top 10%) Self-Governed: You don’t need a GPS to find a target. You own your territory like it’s your own franchise. Fluent in Results: You don't brag about how many "calls" you made; you brag about the revenue you closed.

Resilient: You have the "softball" mentality for people—gentle enough to build instant rapport—but the "hardball" mentality for the deal. Elite Communicator: You possess near-native command of English (C1/C2 level) and preferably one or more European languages to negotiate with C-suite executives and navigate complex objections.

The Mission (Days on Road) 80% Field Presence: You will spend 4 days a week on the road. You will be expected to master your territory through face-to-face combat—meeting prospects where they live and work. Strategic Hunting: You will identify, qualify, and close high-value accounts independently. Full Accountability: You manage your own pipeline.

We provide the CRM; you provide the data that shows why you’re winning. What We Offer (The Upside) Uncapped Commissions: We don't believe in "ceiling" your success. If you bring in the revenue, you keep the lion's share. Zero Micro-Management: We don't care where you are at 10:00 AM as long as your numbers are at 120% of quota.

High-Stakes Environment: You will be surrounded by other high-performers. If you are the smartest person in the room, you are in the wrong room. Requirements Proven Track Record: You can provide a 12-month stack-ranking showing you in the top decile of your previous sales force.

Mobility: A European driving licence and a willingness to be "on the road" constantly. Stamina: Physical and mental endurance for long days and high-pressure negotiations. Fully Remote, Europe Originally posted on Himalayas

We call it a pain chain: symptom, root cause, business cost. And: No chain, no meeting; the AE will send it back for further qualification. Qualification calls that go long enough to build a real case, not just confirm that someone picked up
Re-engagement on accounts that have been approached before, with a genuine plan for how to get in differently
Follow-up calls with yourself when a first conversation doesn't go deep enough, rather than booking something that isn't ready
Finding your own contacts when the data isn't clean, because it often isn't
Keeping HubSpot honest so your pipeline reflects reality
Working closely enough with your AE that what you hand off actually lands

Wir suchen keinen reinen Sales\-Assistenten, sondern eine vertriebsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die als zentraler Dreh\- und Angelpunkt für unsere anspruchsvollsten Marktsegmente fungiert. Wenn Du Lust hast, innovative Gaslösungen proaktiv am Markt zu platzieren und echte Erfolge zu feiern, dann bist Du bei uns richtig.

Erfahrung und Wissen kannst Du Dir bei uns aneignen – die richtige Einstellung, das Mindset und deine Persönlichkeit bringst Du mit. Wir suchen niemanden, der schon alles , sondern jemanden, der bereit ist, anzupacken, Probleme zu lösen und ständig dazuzulernen.
In dieser Rolle bist du weit mehr als "Inside Sales" – du bist Berater, Stratege und Beziehungsmanager in einem:
Wachstumstreiber: Du identifizierst eigenständig Potenziale, verwandelst Leads in langfristige Partnerschaften und bringst unsere Spezialanwendungen (GMP \& Lebensmittelrecht) aktiv an den Kunden.
Omnichannel\-Profi: Ob Video\-Call, E\-Mail oder Telefon – du nutzt moderne Kanäle, um Kunden kompetent zu Produkten und Dienstleistungen zu beraten.
Portfoliomanager: Du verwaltest dein Kundenportfolio unter dem Aspekt der nachhaltigen Rentabilität und sicherst durch mehrjährige Verträge die gemeinsame Zukunft.
Netzwerker: Als Bindeglied zwischen Marketing, Engineering und Customer Service stellst du sicher, dass auch komplexe Kundenanforderungen effizient umgesetzt werden.
Überzeugt auf ganzer Linie \| Dein Profil
​Du bist kein Verkäufer der "zweiten Reihe", sondern suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du etwas bewegen kannst:
Erfahrung: Du hast eine kaufmännische oder technische Basis und brennst für den Verkauf (ideal 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung).
Branchen\-Know\-how: Du verstehst industrielle Prozesse oder hast erste Einblicke in Schweisstechnik oder in der Lebensmittel\- und Pharmaindustrie.
Sprachtalent: Du überzeugst stilsicher in Deutsch (C1\) und kommunizierst sicher auf ösisch (B1\). Englisch und/oder Italienisch sind ein willkommenes Plus für unser internationales Netzwerk.
Mindset \& Persönlichkeit: Du arbeitest selbstständig, lösungsorientiert und hast eine hohe digitale Affinität. "Safety First" ist für dich eine Lebenseinstellung, kein Buzzword.
Warum Carbagas? Das bieten wir Dir!
Wir wissen, dass Topleistungen ein Top\-Umfeld brauchen. Bei uns erwartet dich kein konservativer "Bürojob", sondern:
Zeitgemässe Arbeitsstruktur: Wir fördern eine hohe Arbeitsqualität durch flexible Rahmenbedingungen. Die Kombination aus Homeoffice und moderner Büro\-Infrastruktur unterstützt dich dabei, komplexe Vertriebsprojekte effizient und zielgerichtet zum Erfolg zu führen.
Mobilität \& Ausstattung: Modernste Ausstattung (Laptop, KI\-Anwendungen) sowie Unterstützung bei der Mobilität (z.B. Beteiligung an ÖV/Halbtax oder Spesenregelung).
Entwicklung: Wir fördern dich! Profitiere von gezielten Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Karrierepfaden innerhalb der Air Liquide Gruppe.
Kultur \& Team: Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen Teams, das flache Hierarchien lebt. Wir feiern Erfolge gemeinsam – bei Teamevents und einer offenen Du\-Kultur.
Sicherheit \& Benefits: Überdurchschnittlicher Lohn sowie Sozialleistungen, attraktive Ferienregelungen und zusätzliche Feiertage.
Unsere Unterschiede machen unsere gemeinsame Leistung aus.
Bei CARBAGAS AG / Air Liquide haben wir uns verpflichtet, ein vielfältiges und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, das die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeiter\*innen, unserer Kund\*innen, Patient\*innen, Interessengruppen und Kulturen auf der ganzen Welt berücksichtigt.
Wir begrüssen und berücksichtigen Bewerbungen von allen qualifizierten Bewerber\*innen, unabhängig von ihrem Hintergrund. Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass eine vielfältige Organisation den Menschen die Möglichkeit bietet, ihre Talente sowohl individuell als auch gemeinschaftlich zum Ausdruck zu bringen. Und dass sie unsere innovationsfähigkeit fördert, indem wir unsere Grundsätze leben, für unseren Erfolg handeln und ein engagiertes Umfeld in einer sich wandelnden Welt schaffen.

s.h: ## CE QUE TU PEUX FAIRE BOUGER ##
s.t:
Tu souhaites faire évoluer les clients, tu es à l'aise dans le monde Microsoft Cloud, plateformes et sécurité et tu as le sens des opportunités et des défis que la digitalisation offre à nos clients et à leurs entreprises ?

Alors tu es exactement à la bonne place chez nous dans le Business Development pour le Microsoft Competence Center chez adesso !

En lien avec tes connaissances informatiques de base, tu agis comme interface centrale entre nos clients, les ventes et nos consultants, lorsqu'il s'agit de l'orientation professionnelle et stratégique d'adesso dans le domaine des Microsoft Clouds, plateformes et solutions de sécurité.
En tant que Business Developer, tu es le partenaire d'échange des cadres et de nos Account Managers pour la croissance et tu convaincs nos clients par ta grande expertise dans le monde Microsoft - du Cloud et des plateformes jusqu'à la sécurité.

s.h: De plus, les tâches suivantes t'attendent
s.t:
* Tu mets tes idées en œuvre avec enthousiasme dans le développement de solutions numériques sur mesure et sécurisées
* Tu identifies les besoins en sécurité et les potentiels commerciaux chez nos clients et développes avec nos consultants des solutions adaptées autour de Microsoft Security - de l'identité et la conformité à la protection contre les menaces et aux opérations de sécurité
* Grâce à une communication forte combinée à ta grande expertise professionnelle et ton talent organisationnel, tu gagnes tes clients en prévente et orchestras notre équipe de prévente
* Sur la base de la planification de comptes que tu as élaborée, tu atteins tes objectifs avec succès
* En collaboration avec les ventes et les cadres du Microsoft Competence Center, tu assures notre succès dans l'acquisition de clients et de commandes

s.h: ## DONNEUR DE CHANCES - CE QUI FAIT ADESSO ##
s.t:
Notre promesse : tu te sentiras bien chez nous ! Collégial, communautaire et sur un pied d'égalité - nous vivons l'échange, l'esprit d'équipe et un respect mutuel. La diversité et les différents points de vue sont aussi appréciés chez nous que toi en tant que personne. Cela et bien plus encore représente notre sentiment très particulier d'appartenance. Pour lequel il existe même un mot : adessi.
* **Apprends et grandis avec nous :** Avec plus de 400 offres de formation et notre plateforme d'apprentissage numérique, nous soutenons ton développement continu.
